test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What happens when concentrated hydrochloric acid is added to manganese dioxide?

options.text: Hydrochloric acid is reduced to chlorine gas.
Manganese dioxide is reduced to manganese (II) chloride.
Hydrochloric acid is reduced while MnO2 is oxidised.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Manganese dioxide is reduced to manganese (II) chloride**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• When concentrated hydrochloric acid (HCl) is added to manganese dioxide (MnO2), a redox reaction takes place.
 
• In this reaction, manganese dioxide (MnO2) is reduced to manganese (II) chloride (MnCl2).
 
• Hydrochloric acid (HCl) is oxidized to chlorine gas (Cl2).
 
• The balanced chemical equation for this reaction is: MnO2 + 4 HCl → MnCl2 + 2 H2O + Cl2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Redox Reactions:**

 
 
• Redox reactions are chemical reactions in which the oxidation states of atoms are changed.
 
• These reactions involve the transfer of electrons between chemical species.
 
• In a redox reaction, one substance is oxidized (loses electrons) and another is reduced (gains electrons).
 
 
 
• **Manganese Dioxide (MnO2):**
 
 
• Manganese dioxide is a chemical compound with the formula MnO2.
 
• It is commonly used as a catalyst and as an oxidizing agent in various chemical reactions.
 
• MnO2 is also used in the production of batteries, specifically alkaline and zinc-carbon batteries.
 
 
 
• **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl):**
 
 
• Hydrochloric acid is a strong, corrosive acid that is commonly used in laboratory and industrial applications.
 
• It is a solution of hydrogen chloride (HCl) in water.
 
• HCl is used in the production of chloride salts, as a pH regulator, and in various chemical synthesis processes.
 
 
 
• **Chlorine Gas (Cl2):**
 
 
• Chlorine gas is a greenish-yellow gas that is highly reactive and toxic.
 
• It is used in the production of chlorinated compounds, disinfection of drinking water, and in the bleaching process of paper and textiles.
 
• Chlorine gas can be harmful if inhaled and should be handled with caution.
